rationale: The replication successfully reproduces all 6 symmetry-dictated qualitative features (p-wave oddness, enantiomer flip, mirror relations, OAM>>SAM) using a minimal tight-binding model surrogate, with machine-precision agreement on symmetry checks. However, the paper's core evidence is DFT+Wannier calculations and CD-ARPES experiments on real (TaSe4)2I, none of which were actually run. The model surrogate validates the symmetry logic but does not test material-specific band energies, quantitative CD-ARPES node positions, or the experimental measurements. Coverage is limited because the reproducible physics core is only a fraction of the paper's full claims.
